notes.title: DEADPOINT HDRP Development Blog
notes.content:
Hey Survivors!
In this development update, we are going to share things that are planned and in progress for the next update, Pre Alpha 0.7.

[h2]HDRP and Unity 6[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592067/a603a3e598a339dd11bcdc6304d41c36fa69f0bd.png[/img]
Unity 6 has been released, and we realized that we could be missing out on new features and upgrades if we dont move to the HDRP pipeline, since the original built-in pipeline DEADPOINT is using is going to be deprecated.

The migration to HDRP will take a while, maybe about 1-2 months, but after the moving to HDRP, DEADPOINT could have much more graphical and performance improvements.

[h2]Map Expansion[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592067/b4910b989b66d71a377df0cf4ce23f170064c755.png[/img]
note : image above is still in heavy WIP, and are rendered in built-in pipeline.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592067/7a38d828451a34153e899b5605ae2ff02641362e.png[/img]
A map expansion update is planned for Pre Alpha 0.7. This new expansion featured new areas like a small town, hospital, and more.

[h2]Beds and Respawn[/h2]
Sleeping bags are going to be available in Pre Alpha 0.7. You can only have 1 functioning sleeping bag for respawn, so if you spawn several sleeping bags, you're going to respawn at the last sleeping bag you placed. Respawn has also been worked on, now you can loot back your items from where you previously died.

Thats it for the major changes, we hope you like the direction we are going for the next update! If you had any suggestions feel free to leave it on the Steam forum or Discord! 
We will address minor changes on the update. Thank you.

-Levi, Lead Developer

notes.title: Development Update #03
notes.content:
Hey Survivors, Happy New Year!
In this development update, we are going to share things that are planned and in progress for the next update, Pre Alpha 0.6.

[h3]INVENTORY SYSTEM[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592067/c0699be20fd25890fe2996a45d7e96cf227b0e59.png[/img]
(The inventory preview above is NOT FINAL, and still contains placeholder assets)
Inventory system has been completely overhauled, now utilizing grid-based inventory. New inventory features has also been added (Item action options, containers, etc).

[h3]CHARACTER MODEL[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592067/e6cfa91c67ccc172c84084858fe35ef0db78d5db.png[/img]
Character model has been updated, adding more equipment items such as clothes and gears.

[h3]AI OVERHAUL[/h3]
The AI system has been overhauled, bringing more realistic AI behaviour and animation.

[h3]SCAVS[/h3]
AI scavenger is currently being worked on. They will roam around the map, and will shoot you if they spot you.

[h3]GRAPHICAL IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
Distance/soft shadows has been implemented. Distance objects can now cast shadows without impacting the performance too much. Shadows will now appear more realisticly with soft shadows.

A new, better, and more performant global illumination also been implemented.
All right, thats it for Development Update 3, see you guys in Pre Alpha 0.6
Thank you!

-Levi, Region Interactive
